class.name: CgameOcclusionRaster
class.brief_description: Software occlusion culling with a low-resolution depth buffer and a Hi-Z pyramid.
class.description: [CgameOcclusionRaster] rasterizes occluder triangles into a small conservative depth buffer on the CPU and answers visibility queries for bounding boxes using a max-depth mip chain (Hi-Z), so a query touches only a few texels whatever the box size. Depth is the view distance (clip-space w), which is linear and independent of reversed-Z or other clip conventions. Larger values are farther; texels without an occluder hold infinity. Only perspective projections are supported. All answers are conservative: when unsure, the box is reported visible. Boxes that cross or lie behind the near plane are always visible. Typical per-frame usage: [codeblock] var raster = CgameOcclusionRaster.new() raster.begin(view_proj, 256, 128) # view_proj: world-to-clip matrix. raster.rasterize_occluder(wall_triangles) if raster.is_visible(object_aabb): draw(object) [/codeblock]

method.name: begin
method.description: Starts a frame: clears the depth buffer to infinity, resets the statistics and stores [param view_proj], the world-to-clip matrix. The previous frame's depth is kept for [method temporal_reproject]. [param width] and [param height] are clamped to at least 1.

method.name: build_hiz
method.description: Rebuilds the max-depth mip pyramid. Queries call this automatically when the depth buffer changed, so calling it manually is only needed to measure or force the cost.

method.name: hiz_get
method.description: Returns the Hi-Z texel at [param x], [param y] of mip [param level]. Level 0 is the depth buffer itself. Returns [code]0.0[/code] and prints an error when an argument is out of range or [method begin] was not called.

method.name: hiz_level_count
method.description: Returns the number of Hi-Z levels. The last level is 1x1.

method.name: hiz_size
method.description: Returns the size in texels of the Hi-Z [param level].

method.name: is_visible
method.description: Returns [code]false[/code] only when [param aabb] is provably hidden behind the rasterized occluders. Increases [member tested] and, when the box is hidden, [member culled].

method.name: rasterize_occluder
method.description: Rasterizes world-space triangles, three vertices each, into the depth buffer. Triangles are double sided and clipped against the near plane. Depth is pushed slightly away from the camera so that partially covered pixels never over-occlude. Call after [method begin].

method.name: temporal_reproject
method.description: Seeds the current depth buffer with the previous frame's depth, reprojected from [param prev_view_proj]. Call after [method begin] and before [method rasterize_occluder]. The result is approximate: depth is pushed 5% farther and disocclusions can leak stale occluders.

method.name: test_many
method.description: Tests an array of [AABB] and returns one byte per box: [code]1[/code] when visible, [code]0[/code] when occluded.

members.member: Number of boxes found hidden since [method begin].
Number of triangles rasterized since [method begin], after near-plane rejection.
Number of depth pixels that received their first occluder since [method begin].
Number of boxes tested since [method begin].
